delivery.commit_subject: SVC-EVO-001: add evolution service Dockerfile and compose entry

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Copilot while Codex completes higher-priority work.
Dockerfile and docker-compose entry created for evolution service on port 8093. depends_on runtime-manager and governance (both service_healthy). Volume evolution-data added. Ready for review.

Review changes requested: evolution compose wiring must align with the shared incident/postmortem store. services/evolution/main.py reads IncidentStore for linked_postmortem validation and reverse-link writes, but docker-compose.yml sets INCIDENT_DATA_DIR=/data/incident without mounting incident-data. In compose this points evolution at an empty private path, so EVO-003 incident/postmortem linkage breaks. Mount incident-data and align the path with the shared /data/incidents store before re-handoff.
INCIDENT_DATA_DIR corrected to /data/incidents and incident-data volume mounted. Evolution now shares the same incident store path as incident/postmortem services. Ready for re-review.
Re-review passed: evolution compose wiring now matches the shared /data/incidents store, and fresh validation succeeded with docker compose build/up plus /health 200.
